snippet.title: Roguelite Station-Building Survival in Space - Devlog 01
snippet.description:
A roguelite station-building survival game about keeping a fragile fleet alive in a hostile galaxy. It is currently in early development.

📬 Newsletter: https://tinyurl.com/msckjs2h

Project Overview:
You command three ark ships - the last survivors of a broken Earth - as they travel from system to system in a hostile galaxy. In each new system, you build a temporary space station to turn raw materials into the energy needed for your next jump.

The more power you generate, the more attention you draw from the Swarm: a relentless, energy-hungry threat that will eventually overwhelm you if you take too long in the system.

Given the existential nature of the journey, the hostility of space, and the impending dread of the swarm, you must also manage your crew’s descent into madness.

In this devlog I share an overview of the first prototype, which includes:
- Sending ships to different planets at relativistic speeds across a procedurally generated star system
- Building stations with early modules for power, heat, crew, and defense
- Managing trade-offs between the mission goal (energy), immediate threats (survival), and long term problems (crew madness)
- Early explorations in the Swarm’s behaviour 

Next steps
From here the focus is on the 'intermission' (repairs & upgrades between missions) and moving toward a playable demo with balanced systems.

Stay connected
If you’d like to follow along:
- Subscribe here for more devlogs
- Sign up to the newsletter for milestone updates and early playtesting: https://tinyurl.com/msckjs2h
